draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.89, the 185th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 22nd of 32 at WR. He went 159th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (185th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: broad jump (81st percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (3rd percentile), 10-yard split (7th percentile). College production: 430 receiving yards in 2022, 29th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 46 career games and 18 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2023. Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 2.2 (5th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 332 receiving yards against a median of 346, below the norm.
